rules.title: Deprecated or Prohibited Algorithm
rules.explanation: The algorithm is deprecated or prohibited by current cryptographic standards.

rules.title: Cryptographically Broken Algorithm
rules.explanation: The algorithm is cryptographically broken by classical attacks.

rules.title: Quantum-Vulnerable Key Establishment
rules.explanation: A key-establishment mechanism vulnerable to Shor algorithm was observed. Session keys may be exposed to Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later attacks.

rules.title: Quantum-Vulnerable Digital Signature
rules.explanation: A digital signature algorithm vulnerable to Shor algorithm was observed. Signatures can be forged by a sufficiently capable quantum computer.

rules.title: Quantum-Vulnerable Public Key Encryption
rules.explanation: A public-key encryption mechanism vulnerable to Shor algorithm was observed.

rules.title: Symmetric Key Weakened by Grover
rules.explanation: Symmetric encryption with fewer than 256-bit keys is weakened by Grover algorithm (effective security halved). AES-256 or equivalent recommended.

rules.title: Expired Certificate
rules.explanation: The certificate has expired. Connections using this certificate cannot be verified.

rules.title: Certificate Trust Validation Failed
rules.explanation: Certificate trust validation was performed and failed. The certificate chain cannot be verified.

rules.title: Legacy TLS Version Negotiated
rules.explanation: A legacy TLS version was negotiated. TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are deprecated by RFC 8996.

rules.title: Legacy TLS Version Supported
rules.explanation: A legacy TLS version is supported (not necessarily negotiated). Supporting deprecated versions increases attack surface.

rules.title: PQC Not Negotiated for Key Establishment
rules.explanation: Key establishment was observed at network level without post-quantum hybrid support.

rules.title: Partial PQC Readiness
rules.explanation: Hybrid key exchange negotiated but certificate authentication uses classical signatures. Full PQC readiness requires both.

rules.title: HNDL Exposure on Reachable Endpoint
rules.explanation: Quantum-vulnerable key establishment on a network-reachable endpoint creates Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later exposure.

rules.title: Unknown Algorithm Parameters
rules.explanation: Algorithm parameters (key size, curve) are unknown. Risk cannot be fully assessed.

rules.title: Scanner Unavailable
rules.explanation: Scanner was unavailable. This is NOT evidence that the algorithm is unsupported.
